massage.definition: Kneading and rubbing parts of the body to increase circulation and promote relaxation.

body-wrap.definition: A spa treatment in which the body is covered or wrapped with a product such as clay, cream, or fabric for a period of time.
body-wrap.exampleUsage: The spa menu describes a body wrap as a skin-care treatment.

scrub.definition: The act of cleaning a surface by rubbing it with a brush and soap and water.

manicure.definition: A treatment that cleans, shapes, and cares for fingernails.

pedicure.definition: Professional care for the feet and toenails.

aromatherapy.definition: The therapeutic use of aromatic plant extracts and essential oils in baths or massage.

hot-stone.definition: Relating to a massage or treatment that uses smooth stones warmed before being placed on or moved over the body.
hot-stone.exampleUsage: The therapist prepared smooth stones for a hot-stone treatment.

deep-tissue.definition: Relating to massage that applies firm pressure to deeper layers of muscles and connective tissue.
deep-tissue.exampleUsage: The brochure lists deep-tissue massage as a firm-pressure treatment.

reflexology.definition: Massage to relieve tension by finger pressure.

swedish.definition: Of or relating to or characteristic of Sweden or its people or culture or language.

exfoliation.definition: The peeling off in flakes or scales of bark or dead skin.

body-scrub.definition: A skin treatment that uses a textured product to remove dead cells from the body's surface.
body-scrub.exampleUsage: The body scrub was rinsed away after the treatment.

seaweed-wrap.definition: A spa body treatment in which a seaweed-based product is applied before the body is wrapped for a period of time.
seaweed-wrap.exampleUsage: The seaweed wrap was listed among the spa's body treatments.

facial-mask.definition: A skin-care product spread over the face and left for a short time before being removed or rinsed off.
facial-mask.exampleUsage: The facial mask was applied evenly and later rinsed away.

clay-mask.definition: A facial or body mask made mainly with clay and used as a skin-care treatment.
clay-mask.exampleUsage: The clay mask dried slightly before it was washed off.

cucumber.definition: A melon vine of the genus Cucumis.

thai-massage.definition: A traditional style of bodywork that combines pressure, assisted stretching, and movement.
thai-massage.exampleUsage: The spa brochure describes Thai massage as a form of assisted bodywork.

sports-massage.definition: Massage aimed at muscles used in physical activity, often for relaxation or recovery after exercise.
sports-massage.exampleUsage: The athlete booked a sports-massage session after training.

lymphatic-drainage.definition: A gentle massage technique intended to encourage the movement of lymph fluid through the body.
lymphatic-drainage.exampleUsage: The clinic describes lymphatic drainage as a gentle manual technique.

cupping-therapy.definition: A traditional treatment in which cups create suction on the skin; evidence for many claimed benefits is limited.
cupping-therapy.exampleUsage: The spa listed cupping therapy and noted that clients should discuss health concerns with a qualified professional.

hot-stone-therapy.definition: A spa treatment that uses warmed smooth stones as part of a massage or relaxation session.
hot-stone-therapy.exampleUsage: Hot-stone therapy uses warmed stones as part of the session.

cold-therapy.definition: The controlled use of cold on the body for a limited time, often for comfort or recovery purposes.
cold-therapy.exampleUsage: The wellness center describes cold therapy as a supervised treatment using low temperatures.

hydrotherapy.definition: The internal and external use of water in the treatment of disease.

flotation-tank.definition: A tank filled with highly salty water in which a person can float with very little effort.
flotation-tank.exampleUsage: The flotation tank contains salt-rich water that helps the body float.

mineral-bath.definition: A bath in water containing dissolved minerals, used for relaxation or spa treatment.
mineral-bath.exampleUsage: The mineral bath was filled with warm mineral-rich water.

paraffin-wax-treatment.definition: A spa treatment in which warm paraffin wax is applied to the hands or feet and later removed.
paraffin-wax-treatment.exampleUsage: The paraffin-wax treatment was offered for hands and feet.

foot-soak.definition: The act of placing the feet in warm water, sometimes with added salts or other products.
foot-soak.exampleUsage: The session began with a warm foot soak.

scalp-treatment.definition: A hair- or skin-care treatment applied to the scalp for cleansing, conditioning, or comfort.
scalp-treatment.exampleUsage: The scalp treatment was followed by a gentle rinse.

facial-steamer.definition: A device that produces warm steam for use during facial skin-care treatments.
facial-steamer.exampleUsage: The facial steamer released a gentle mist of warm steam.

dermaroller.definition: A hand-held cosmetic device covered with many very small needles that roll over the skin; it should be used only with appropriate hygiene and professional guidance.
dermaroller.exampleUsage: The clinic keeps the dermaroller sterile and uses it only under trained supervision.

led-light-therapy.definition: A cosmetic or wellness treatment that exposes the skin to light from light-emitting diodes of selected wavelengths.
led-light-therapy.exampleUsage: The treatment room has an LED-light-therapy panel.

sauna.definition: A heated room in which people sit to sweat and relax.

steam-room.definition: A heated room designed for bathing in steam; in Britain, it is also called a vapour bath.

hot-tub.definition: A large bathing tub is filled with heated water and can hold several people at once.

pool.definition: A small body of standing water (rainwater) or other liquid.

relaxation-room.definition: A quiet room designed for resting before or after a spa treatment.
relaxation-room.exampleUsage: Guests sat quietly in the relaxation room.

shower.definition: A place or device that sprays water over you so you can wash your body.
shower.exampleUsage: The shower was used during the activity.

locker-room.definition: A room in a sports facility or workplace where people change clothes and leave personal belongings in lockers.

reception.definition: The manner in which something is greeted.

terrace.definition: A row of houses built in a similar style and having common dividing walls (or the street on which they face).

plunge-pool.definition: A small pool designed for brief immersion rather than swimming long distances.
plunge-pool.exampleUsage: The spa has a small plunge pool beside the sauna area.

salt-room.definition: A room designed for relaxation in a dry environment containing salt surfaces or salt particles.
salt-room.exampleUsage: The salt room has walls covered with decorative salt blocks.

mud-bath.definition: A treatment in which a person soaks in warm mud to ease rheumatic pain.

towel-warmer.definition: A heated cabinet or device used to keep towels warm before use.
towel-warmer.exampleUsage: Clean towels were placed in the towel warmer.

infrared-sauna.definition: A heated enclosure that uses infrared radiant heat rather than only heating the surrounding air.
infrared-sauna.exampleUsage: The infrared sauna uses radiant heaters inside the cabin.

cryotherapy.definition: A medical or wellness term for treatments that use very low temperatures; some forms require trained professional supervision.
cryotherapy.exampleUsage: The clinic explains that cryotherapy should be provided with appropriate safety precautions.

salt-scrub.definition: A skin scrub made with salt crystals and a base such as oil or gel.
salt-scrub.exampleUsage: The salt scrub was massaged gently over the skin and rinsed away.

sugar-scrub.definition: A skin scrub made with sugar crystals and a base such as oil or cream.
sugar-scrub.exampleUsage: The sugar scrub had a coarse texture.

coffee-scrub.definition: A skin-care scrub containing ground coffee particles as an exfoliating ingredient.
coffee-scrub.exampleUsage: The coffee scrub was listed as an exfoliating body treatment.

clay-wrap.definition: A spa treatment in which clay is applied to the body before it is wrapped for a limited time.
clay-wrap.exampleUsage: The clay wrap was followed by a shower.

detox-wrap.definition: A marketing term for a body-wrap spa treatment promoted as refreshing or cleansing; claims that it removes toxins are not well established.
detox-wrap.exampleUsage: The spa menu calls the treatment a detox wrap, although such toxin-removal claims are not well established.

essential-oil.definition: A concentrated liquid taken from plants contains their easily released scent compounds. It does not mix with water and is usually made by distilling, pressing, or using a solvent.

lotion.definition: A smooth liquid put on the skin to protect or soften it.

cream.definition: To put on cream, as on one's face or body.

mask.definition: Activity that tries to conceal something.

serum.definition: An amber, watery fluid, rich in proteins, that separates out when blood coagulates.
serum.exampleUsage: The glossary uses the term "Serum" in an educational description.

mud.definition: To soil with mud, muck, or mire.

incense.definition: The pleasing scent produced when incense is burned.

herb.definition: A plant lacking a permanent woody stem.

diffuser.definition: Optical device that distributes the light of a lamp evenly.
diffuser.exampleUsage: The diffuser was used during the activity.

moisturizer.definition: A cosmetic product applied to the skin to restore moisture and help prevent dryness.

toner.definition: A lotion for cleansing the skin and contracting the pores.

cleanser.definition: A preparation used in cleaning something.

eye-cream.definition: A cosmetic cream formulated for the delicate skin around the eyes.
eye-cream.exampleUsage: The eye cream was applied gently around the eye area.

aloe-vera-gel.definition: A gel containing material from aloe vera leaves, commonly used in skin-care products.
aloe-vera-gel.exampleUsage: The aloe vera gel had a light, cooling texture.

jojoba-oil.definition: A liquid wax obtained from jojoba seeds and commonly used in cosmetic and skin-care products.
jojoba-oil.exampleUsage: The massage blend contained a small amount of jojoba oil.

coconut-oil.definition: An edible oil extracted from coconut meat is used in cooking, baking, processed foods, cosmetics, and soap production.

eucalyptus-oil.definition: A concentrated plant oil extracted from the leaves of eucalyptus trees.

lavender-oil.definition: An aromatic essential oil obtained from lavender and used in fragrances and some cosmetic products.
lavender-oil.exampleUsage: The room fragrance contained lavender oil.

tea-tree-oil.definition: A strongly scented essential oil obtained from the tea tree plant and used in some skin-care products; concentrated oil can irritate skin.
tea-tree-oil.exampleUsage: The product label warns that concentrated tea tree oil may irritate sensitive skin.

peppermint-oil.definition: An aromatic essential oil obtained from peppermint and used in fragrances and some personal-care products; concentrated oil may irritate skin.
peppermint-oil.exampleUsage: The product contained diluted peppermint oil for fragrance.

lip-balm.definition: A soft product put on the lips to stop them becoming dry or sore.

massage-table.definition: A padded table designed to support a person during massage or body treatments.
massage-table.exampleUsage: The therapist adjusted the height of the massage table.

towel.definition: A piece of absorbent cloth used for drying your body or other things.

headband.definition: A band worn around or over the head.

eye-mask.definition: A soft fabric covering placed over the eyes to shut out light while sleeping or relaxing.

heated-bed.definition: A treatment or relaxation bed with a built-in system that warms its surface.
heated-bed.exampleUsage: The heated bed was set to a comfortable temperature.

basin.definition: The quantity that a basin will hold.

headrest.definition: A cushion attached to the top of the back of an automobile's seat to prevent whiplash.

heated-blanket.definition: A blanket containing an electrical heating element that provides controlled warmth.
heated-blanket.exampleUsage: The heated blanket was used according to its safety instructions.

meditation-cushion.definition: A firm cushion designed to support a comfortable seated position during meditation.
meditation-cushion.exampleUsage: She sat on a meditation cushion in the quiet room.

zen-garden.definition: A carefully arranged garden, often using rocks, gravel, and simple planting, designed to create a calm visual space.
zen-garden.exampleUsage: A small Zen garden decorated the relaxation area.

water-feature.definition: A decorative feature in a garden or other landscape uses water to provide visual movement or an audible effect.

bamboo-mat.definition: A mat made from thin pieces or fibers of bamboo.
bamboo-mat.exampleUsage: A bamboo mat covered part of the wooden floor.

stone-pathway.definition: A walking path made from stones or paving slabs.
stone-pathway.exampleUsage: The stone pathway led from the garden to the spa entrance.

meditation.definition: Continuous and profound contemplation or musing on a subject or series of subjects of a deep or abstruse nature.

yoga.definition: A system of physical, breathing and meditation exercises practiced to promote control of the body and mind.

breathing.definition: Passing or able to pass air in and out of the lungs normally.

mindfulness.definition: The trait of staying aware of (paying close attention to) your responsibilities.

stretching.definition: Moving your body to loosen muscles and improve flexibility.

detox.definition: The hospital ward or clinic in which patients are detoxified.

hydration.definition: The process of combining with water.

sleep.definition: A torpid state resembling deep sleep.

balance.definition: Harmonious arrangement or relation of parts or elements within a whole (as in a design).

relaxation.definition: An occurrence of control or strength weakening.

herbal-tea.definition: This beverage is prepared by steeping plant parts, including leaves, flowers, seeds, or roots, in hot water. Unlike ordinary tea, it usually contains no leaves from the Camellia sinensis plant.

infused-water.definition: Water flavored by soaking pieces of fruit, herbs, or other ingredients in it.
infused-water.exampleUsage: A jug of infused water contained cucumber and mint.

ambient-music.definition: Soft background music intended to create a particular atmosphere without demanding close attention.
ambient-music.exampleUsage: Ambient music played quietly in the relaxation room.

acupuncture.definition: Treatment of pain or disease by inserting the tips of needles at specific points on the skin.

shiatsu.definition: Treatment of symptoms by applying pressure with the fingers to specific pressure points on the body.

hot-wax.definition: Warm cosmetic wax used in some beauty treatments, especially hair removal or paraffin treatments.
hot-wax.exampleUsage: The technician checked the hot wax temperature before applying it.

meditation-room.definition: A quiet room set aside for meditation, breathing practice, or silent reflection.
meditation-room.exampleUsage: The meditation room has simple seating and low lighting.

therapist.definition: A person skilled in a particular type of therapy.

esthetician.definition: A worker skilled in giving beauty treatments (manicures and facials etc.).

receptionist.definition: A secretary whose main duty is to answer the telephone and receive visitors.

nail-technician.definition: A trained worker who provides cosmetic care and treatments for fingernails and toenails.
nail-technician.exampleUsage: The nail technician prepared clean tools before the appointment.

masseuse.definition: A woman whose job is to give massages.

yoga-instructor.definition: A person trained to teach yoga movements, breathing, and relaxation practices.
yoga-instructor.exampleUsage: The yoga instructor demonstrated a gentle stretching sequence.

attendant.definition: Being present (at a meeting or event, etc.).

concierge.definition: A French caretaker of apartments or a hotel.

nutritionist.definition: A specialist in the study of nutrition.

trainer.definition: A person who trains other persons or animals.
trainer.exampleUsage: The trainer was identified during the lesson.
